description: The agent side of swarm cards. A feature or task agent's brief now teaches the card loop: start the card, keep the handoff current, finish with a result and how-to-validate steps, release when stuck, and never mark a card done. A project agent's standing rules add how to run the queue: deal the top cards in order, hold when nothing should start, split big cards, accept or reject reports and suggest reorders. Every wake, fresh or resumed, repeats a short card duty. A dealt card's message lists up to three facts its chain already knows, with their ids, so what a parent learned travels down, and a spawned child's first message lists them next to its card. The huddle guide moves to revision 6 and teaches plain sessions the four columns, that a swarm-held card refuses huddle state writes, and that only you reach Done. Backend only: the board screen waits for the layout pick.
examples: Spawn a task agent and read its brief: section 4 tells it to start its card, write a handoff as it goes and finish with how to validate.
Deal a card to an agent whose parent remembered a related fact: the deal message names that fact with its f_ id.
Spawn a task agent whose parent remembered a related fact: the child's first message names that fact with its f_ id.
how_to: Read a project agent's creation brief or its next wake to see the dealing rules after its delegation sentence.
Call huddle_guide and check guide_rev is 6; section 18 is the cards section.
Kill a fact you do not want passed down with DELETE /api/v1/swarm/facts/{fact_id}.
media_exempt: backend only; the board UI waits for the layout pick
name: swarm cards: agent rules and learning down
summary: swarm agents are taught the card loop in their briefs and on every wake, project agents get the dealing rules, a dealt card carries the facts its chain already knows, and the huddle guide moves to rev 6.
where: Backend only for now: the rules reach agents through their briefs, wake texts and the huddle guide. The board screen arrives in a later slice.
